Question B-005-005-005.

Why the correct answer is right: Series resistors are connected end-to-end, so the same current passes through each one. Their values add, making the total larger than any one resistor in the string.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "less than the resistance of any one resistor": That describes the usual result for resistors in parallel, not in series.
- sourceIndex 2: "equal to the highest resistance present": The highest resistor is only one part of the path. The smaller series resistors still add resistance.
- sourceIndex 3: "equal to the lowest resistance present": The lowest resistor cannot represent the whole chain because all series resistances are included in the total.
